entities.summary: Owen John Dolan was the Coadjutor Bishop Emeritus of Palmerston North. He was appointed coadjutor bishop by Pope John Paul II on 2 November 1995 and was consecrated on 10 December 1995. He retired on 30 September 2004. He died in Palmerston North on 28 April 2025, at the age of 96.
